segments.name: Growth-Stage Managing Partners
segments.description: Partners at 10-50 attorney firms looking to scale revenue without proportional cost increases. They have some marketing budget but limited internal resources.
pain_points: Inconsistent case intake month-to-month
Losing prospects to larger competitors with better marketing
High cost per acquired case
Marketing feels like a distraction from client work
Difficulty measuring ROI on marketing spend
content_types: Case study ROI reports with specific metrics
Comparative benchmarking data vs peer firms
Implementation roadmaps with 90-day timelines
White papers on law firm growth models
Webinars with guest partners sharing their growth stories
segments.hook_style: Data-driven success stories with specific revenue gains. Lead with the number (e.g., '3 partners increased case intake 47% in 6 months'). Show the math behind growth.
segments.cta_preference: Schedule 15-min growth audit with your firm's metrics vs industry benchmarks

segments.name: Specialized Practice Leaders
segments.description: Partners or practice heads in niche areas (personal injury, medical malpractice, construction defect, etc.) with established reputation but inconsistent referral pipelines.
pain_points: Over-reliant on personal referrals that dry up
Difficulty competing with national firms in their niche
Low website visibility within their specialty
Don't understand how to market their expertise authentically
Concerned about brand positioning and thought leadership
content_types: Niche-specific marketing playbooks by practice area
Positioning frameworks for specialist practices
Expert authority content templates and distribution guides
Case studies from similar specialized practices
Podcast appearances and speaking opportunity guides
segments.hook_style: Speak to their expertise pride. Position marketing as amplifying their existing authority, not replacing it. Use industry-specific language and examples.
segments.cta_preference: Get a free positioning audit that identifies your unique market advantage

segments.name: Digital-Native Solo/Small Practitioners
segments.description: Solo attorneys and 2-5 person firm owners comfortable with technology, active on LinkedIn, interested in scaling through digital channels.
pain_points: Limited budget for agency services
Want DIY options but lack strategic direction
Overwhelmed by too many marketing tools and platforms
Struggle with content creation consistency
Fear of looking unprofessional or spammy online
content_types: Step-by-step how-to guides and video tutorials
Content templates they can customize and use immediately
LinkedIn strategy and copywriting tips
Affordable tool stacks and SOP documentation
Weekly action items and quick wins they can implement alone
segments.hook_style: Practical, no-BS advice with immediate applications. Show them they can do this without hiring an agency (but subtly show where they'll want help). Lead with quick wins.
segments.cta_preference: Download free case intake optimization checklist

segments.name: Underperforming Marketing-Aware Firms
segments.description: Firms with existing marketing efforts, hire marketing people or agencies, but aren't seeing the case intake results they expected. They're frustrated and skeptical.
pain_points: Previous marketing investments didn't deliver results
In-house marketing person lacking legal expertise
Unclear attribution between marketing activities and signed cases
Working with generic agencies unfamiliar with legal nuances
Wasted budget on vanity metrics (web traffic, leads) vs actual cases
content_types: Audit/diagnostic frameworks to identify what's broken
Legal-specific marketing accountability standards
Before/after case studies with detailed metrics
Reports on common marketing mistakes law firms make
Competitor analysis within their market/practice area
segments.hook_style: Validate their frustration. Show common mistakes other firms made. Position your agency as fixing the broken approach, not starting from scratch. Lead with diagnosis.
segments.cta_preference: Schedule a free marketing performance audit (show exactly where dollars are leaking)
